elements.name: Omin Dran
elements.desc: Medium humanoid (half-elf), lawful neutral. Challenge 5 (1,800 XP).

traits.d: Once on each of its turns when it hits a creature with a weapon attack, Omin can cause the attack to deal an extra 4 (1d8) damage of the same type dealt by the weapon.
Omin has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.

Omin is a 9th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following cleric spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): guidance, sacred flame, spare the dying, thaumaturgy
1st level (4 slots): bless, command, divine favor, shield of faith
2nd level (3 slots): enhance ability, hold person, magic weapon, silence, spiritual weapon
3rd level (3 slots): beacon of hope, crusader's mantle, dispel magic, mass healing word, spirit guardians
4th level (3 slots): death ward, freedom of movement, locate creature, stoneskin
5th level (1 slot): dispel evil and good, flame strike, hold monster, greater restoration, legend lore

actions.d: Omin makes two attacks with his maul.
*Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.n: War God's Blessing (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
reactions.d: When a creature within 30 feet of Omin makes an attack roll, but before learning whether it hits or misses, Omin can grant the creature a +10 bonus to that roll.

elements.name: Jim Darkmagic
elements.desc: Medium humanoid (human), chaotic neutral. Challenge 5 (1,800 XP).

traits.d: Jim carries a wand of wonder.

traits.n: Benign Transportation (Recharges after Jim Casts a Conjuration Spell of 1st Level or Higher)
traits.d: As a bonus action, Jim teleports up to 30 feet to a space he can see. The space must be unoccupied or occupied by a willing Small or Medium creature. If the latter, Jim and the willing creature both teleport, swapping places.

Jim is a 9th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, friends, mage hand, minor illusion, prestidigitation
1st level (4 slots): disguise self, Jim's magic missile*, shield, mage armor
2nd level (3 slots): invisibility, Jim's glowing coin,* scorching ray
3rd level (3 slots): incite greed,* dispel magic, fireball
4th level (3 slots): conjure minor elementals, polymorph
5th level (1 slot): mislead
*New spell introduced in chapter 3

actions.d: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

Jim conjures an inanimate object, no larger than 3 feet on a side and no more than 10 pounds, in his hand or on the ground in an unoccupied space he can see within 10 feet of him. The object is visibly magical, radiating dim light out to 5 feet. It disappears if it takes any damage, after 1 hour, or when Jim uses this feature again.

elements.name: Viari
elements.desc: Medium humanoid (human), chaotic good. Challenge 5 (1,800 XP).

stat.acNote: +1 studded leather; 19 while wielding two melee weapons

traits.d: If Viari is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails. He can't use this trait if he's incapacitated.
Climbing doesn't cost Viari extra movement. Additionally, when he makes a running jump, the distance he covers increases by 5 feet.

Viari deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Viari that isn't incapacitated and Viari doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.d: Viari makes two attacks with his shortsword and two attacks with his rapier.
*Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (1d6 + 6) piercing damage.
*Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.
*Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage.

reactions.d: Viari halves the damage that he takes from an attack that hits him. He must be able to see the attacker.

elements.name: Môrgæn
elements.desc: Medium humanoid (elf), chaotic neutral. Challenge 4 (1,100 XP).

traits.d: Môrgæn has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put her to sleep.

Môrgæn's spellcasting ability is Intelligence. She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: mage hand

Môrgæn is a 9th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following ranger spells prepared:
1st level (4 slots): alarm, animal friendship, hunter's mark
2nd level (3 slots): pass without trace, spike growth
3rd level (2 slots): conjure animals

actions.d: Môrgæn makes three attacks with her scimitars or her longbow.
*Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.
*Ranged Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

elements.name: Flabbergast
elements.desc: Medium humanoid (human), lawful neutral. Challenge 4 (1,100 XP).

traits.d:
Flabbergast is a 9th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation
1st level (4 slots): detect magic, mage armor, magic missile, shield
2nd level (3 slots): gift of gab,* misty step, suggestion
3rd level (3 slots): fast friends,* fly, lightning bolt
4th level (3 slots): greater invisibility
5th level (1 slot): cone of cold
*New spell introduced in chapter 3

actions.d: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

elements.name: Donaar Blit'zen
elements.desc: Medium humanoid (dragonborn), chaotic good. Challenge 3 (700 XP).

traits.n: Champion Challenge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.d: As a bonus action, Donaar causes each creature of his choice that he can see within 30 feet of him to make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature can't willingly move more than 30 feet away from Donaar. This effect ends on the creature if Donaar is incapacitated or dies, or if the creature is moved more than 30 feet away from him.

Donaar is a 5th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following paladin spells prepared:
1st level (4 slots): command, compelled duel, cure wounds, wrathful smite
2nd level (2 slots): aid, branding smite, lesser restoration, warding bond, zone of truth

actions.d: Donaar makes two attacks with his greatsword or his whip.
*Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. Whenever Donaar rolls a 1 or 2 on a damage die, he can reroll the die and must use the new roll.
*Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage.

Donaar regurgitates acid in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

elements.name: K'thriss Drow'b
elements.desc: Medium humanoid (elf), chaotic neutral. Challenge 3 (700 XP).

stat.langs: Celestial, Common, Elvish, Undercommon; can read all writing

traits.d:
K'thriss wears a robe of stars (accounted for in his statistics). The robe allows him to cast the following spells:
6/day: magic missile (7 missiles)
K'thriss can telepathically speak to any creature he can see within 30 feet of him, provided the creature can understand at least one language.
K'thriss has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.
While in sunlight, K'thriss has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

K'thriss's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: dancing lights, disguise self
1/day each: darkness, faerie fire

K'thriss is a 5th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). He regains his expended spell slots when he finishes a short or long rest, and knows the following warlock spells:
Cantrips (at will): chill touch, eldritch blast, mind sliver, prestidigitation, thorn whip, vicious mockery
1st-3rd level (2 3rd-level slots): dissonant whispers, fly, hex, misty step, sending, shatter

actions.d: K'thriss makes two attacks with his sickle.
*Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

elements.name: Rosie Beestinger
elements.desc: Small humanoid (halfling), chaotic good. Challenge 3 (700 XP).

traits.d: Rosie has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
Rosie can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than hers.

If Rosie is subjected to an effect that allows her to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, she instead takes no damage if she succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if she fails. She can't use this trait if she's incapacitated.

When Rosie is in dim light or darkness, she can use a bonus action to teleport 60 feet to an unoccupied space she can see that is also in dim light or darkness. She then has advantage on the first melee attack she makes before the end of the turn.

Rosie's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: minor illusion, sacred flame, thaumaturgy
1/day each: command, darkness, darkvision, pass without trace, silence

actions.d: Rosie makes three attacks, then makes two unarmed strike attacks.
*Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.
*Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. Rosie's unarmed strikes are magical.

reactions.d: In response to being hit by a ranged weapon attack, Rosie deflects the missile. The damage she takes from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + 9. If the damage is reduced to 0, she catches the missile if it's small enough to hold in one hand and she has a hand free.

elements.name: Walnut Dankgrass
elements.desc: Medium humanoid (elf), lawful neutral. Challenge 3 (700 XP).

traits.d: Walnut has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put her to sleep.
Walnut can attempt to hide even when she is only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

traits.n: Wild Shape (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.d:
As a bonus action, Walnut can assume the shape of a dire wolf. She can stay in this form for 3 hours or until she reverts to her normal form as a bonus action. She automatically reverts if she falls unconscious, drops to 0 hit points, or dies.
While transformed, Walnut's game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the dire wolf, except she retains her alignment, personality, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. Her attacks in beast form are magical. In beast form, Walnut can use a bonus action to expend one spell slot and regain 1d8 hit points per level of the spell slot expended.

Walnut is a 7th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following druid spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): druidcraft, produce flame, thorn whip
1st level (4 slots): cure wounds, entangle, thunderwave
2nd level (3 slots): flame blade, moonbeam, pass without trace
3rd level (3 slots): call lightning, dispel magic, plant growth
4th level (1 slot): blight, freedom of movement

actions.d: Walnut makes two attacks with Foremother or her longbow.
*Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.
*Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

elements.name: Brahma Lutier
elements.desc: Medium humanoid (elf), neutral. Challenge 2 (450 XP).

traits.d: Brahma has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put her to sleep.

Brahma is a 4th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following bard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): mage hand, message, vicious mockery
1st level (4 slots): charm person, heroism, illusory script, sleep, unseen servant
2nd level (3 slots): cloud of daggers, invisibility

actions.d: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

Brahma targets one creature that can hear or see her, which must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by her for 1 minute. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. It has disadvantage on these saves if being charmed by Brahma is something the target openly or secretly desires. For 1 hour after the charm effect ends, the target has disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma checks made as part of a contest with Brahma.

elements.name: Oak Truestrike
elements.desc: Medium humanoid (elf), neutral good/neutral evil. Challenge 2 (450 XP).

traits.d: Oak has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.
Oak has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

actions.d: Oak makes three attacks with his hooked daggers or his hand crossbow.
*Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
*Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

reactions.d: When Oak takes damage from a melee weapon attack, he can make a hooked dagger attack.

elements.name: Pendragon Beestinger
elements.desc: Medium humanoid (human), neutral evil. Challenge 2 (450 XP).

traits.d: Pendragon can cast the spell he cast on his last turn, whose casting time becomes 1 bonus action. This bonus casting uses a spell slot as normal.

Pendragon is a 4th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): acid splash, light, mage hand, poison spray, shocking grasp
1st level (4 slots): detect magic, mage armor, magic missile, sleep
2nd level (3 slots): blindness/deafness, cloud of daggers, scorching ray

actions.d: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

elements.name: Phoenix Anvil
elements.desc: Medium humanoid (human), lawful neutral. Challenge 2 (450 XP).

traits.d: As a bonus action, Phoenix causes his shield to flare with divine light. Each creature of his choice within 30 feet of him must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself with a success.

Phoenix is a 4th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following cleric spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): guidance, light, mending, sacred flame
1st level (4 slots): bane, cure wounds, guiding bolt
2nd level (3 slots): hold person, spiritual weapon

actions.d: Phoenix makes two melee attacks.
*Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet.

elements.name: Potentia Dran
elements.desc: Medium monstrosity (shapechanger), lawful evil. Challenge 3 (700 XP).

traits.d: Potentia deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Potentia that isn't incapacitated and Potentia doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.d: Potentia makes three melee attacks.
*Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

Potentia magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating equal to or less than her own, or back into her true form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (her choice). In a new form, Potentia retains her game statistics and ability to speak, but her AC, movement modes, Strength, Dexterity, and special senses are replaced by those of the new form, and she gains any statistics and capabilities (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that she lacks.

elements.name: Auspicia Dran
elements.desc: Medium humanoid (half-elf), neutral good. Challenge 2 (450 XP).

traits.d:
Auspicia's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence. She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:
At will: detect thoughts
1/day: augury

actions.d: Auspicia makes two attacks.
*Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.
*Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

elements.name: Chaos Quadrapod
elements.desc: Large aberration, chaotic evil. Challenge 4 (1,100 XP).

traits.d: The chaos quadrapod has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.d: The chaos quadrapod makes up to two tentacle attacks.

*Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The chaos quadrapod can grapple no more than two targets at a time.

actions.n: Chaos Cloud (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.d: The chaos quadrapod shoots forth a knot of rippling etheral light that explodes at a point it can see within 60 feet of it. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

elements.name: Clockwork Dragon
elements.desc: Medium construct, neutral. Challenge 1 (200 XP).

stat.cimm: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.d: While the clockwork dragon remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a metal statue.

actions.d: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

The clockwork dragon exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

elements.name: Deep Crow
elements.desc: Large monstrosity, unaligned. Challenge 9 (5,000 XP).

traits.d: The deep crow has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
While in dim light or darkness, the deep crow can take the Hide action as a bonus action.
While in sunlight, the deep crow has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.d: The deep crow makes three attacks: one with its mandibles and two with its claws.

*Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the deep crow can't use its mandibles on another target.
*Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

elements.name: Ancient Deep Crow
elements.desc: Huge monstrosity, unaligned. Challenge 15 (13,000 XP).

stat.res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.d: The ancient deep crow has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
While in dim light or darkness, the ancient deep crow can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

actions.d: The ancient deep crow makes three attacks: one with its mandibles and two with its claws.

*Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the ancient deep crow can't use its mandibles on another target.
*Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.

The ancient deep crow releases an ear-splitting caw. Each creature within 60 feet of the crow and able to hear it must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

leg.d: The deep crow makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.
The ancient deep crow uses Shadow Caw.

The ancient deep crow beats its wings. Each creature within 10 feet of the deep crow must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The ancient deep crow can then fly up to half its flying speed.

elements.name: Keg Robot
elements.desc: Medium construct, unaligned. Challenge 2 (450 XP).

stat.res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
stat.cimm: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.d: A keg robot can hold up to three types of liquid payload totaling 12 gallons within its hollow, barrel-shaped body. A full keg robot can make one liquid attack per gallon before the liquid must be refilled. Filling a keg robot takes 2 rounds per gallon. Differing payloads can alter the keg robot's attacks from those presented here.

actions.d: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
*Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 20/40 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (1d8 + 3) acid damage.

The keg robot spews an unnaturally potent beer in a 15-foot cone or in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. While poisoned in this way, a creature has its speed halved by exposure to the potent brew. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Additionally, the beer shower extinguishes any fires or open flames in its area.

The keg robot sprays hot oil in a 15-foot cone or in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 7 (1d8 + 3) fire damage and falls prone. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and doesn't fall prone.
Any creature affected by the hot oil spray that takes fire damage before the oil dries (after 1 minute) takes an additional 3 (1d6) fire damage, and the oil burns away. If the oil that remains in the area of the spray is lit, it burns for 1d4 rounds and deals 3 (1d6) fire damage to any creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there.

elements.name: Splugoth the Returned
elements.desc: Small humanoid (goblinoid), neutral evil. Challenge 2 (450 XP).

traits.d: As long as two or more of Splugoth's allies are within 5 feet of him and are not incapacitated, attack rolls against him are made with disadvantage.
Splugoth can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of his turns.
Splugoth has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

actions.d: Splugoth makes two attacks with his dagger.
*Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

Splugoth remembers and repeats aloud a few words from a place he entered while walking back from the next world to this one. Each creature of his choice within 30 feet of him that can hear him must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

reactions.d: When a creature Splugoth can see hits him with a melee weapon attack, the weapon snags on a pocket of residual resurrectional energy and is caught fast. The attack is negated and the weapon cannot be used until the creature succeeds on a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check as an action to pull it out of Splugoth. Natural weapons can have their attacks negated by this feature, but can then be retracted automatically at the end of the attacking creature's turn.
